 +    from torch.autograd.gradcheck import zero_gradients
 +except ImportError:
 +    from collections.abc import Iterable
 +    def zero_gradients(x):
 +        if isinstance(x, torch.Tensor):
 +            if x.grad is not None:
 +                x.grad.detach_()
 +                x.grad.data.zero_()
 +        elif isinstance(x, Iterable):
